title: PaletteManager
description: Interactive palette editor for semantic theme roles — presets, hex, persistence.

tool.name: mount_palette_manager
tool.description: Mount the PaletteManager editor on the canvas.

props.name: value
props.desc: Active palette mapping (role → tailwind color or hex)

props.name: presets
props.desc: Preset list shown at the top — defaults to the 20-color Tailwind preset set

props.name: storageKey
props.desc: localStorage key for persistence (omit for transient editing)

props.name: roles
props.desc: Roles to render rows for — defaults to 8 semantic roles (primary/secondary/accent/surface/success/warning/danger/info)

props.name: autoApply
props.desc: Apply changes to the DOM on every mutation (vs. requiring an explicit Apply click)

props.name: showPresets
props.desc: Render the preset chooser at the top

props.name: showSave
props.desc: Render the Save / Save As affordances

props.name: compact
props.desc: Tighter row spacing — for sidebars / panels

props.name: icons
props.desc: Override the save / check / presets / hex icons

events.name: onsave
events.desc: Fires when the user saves the current mapping

events.name: onapply
events.desc: Fires when the user clicks Apply (or every change if autoApply)
